description: A product passport: the brand's own listing, then every other store found carrying it, each marked same item, likely same, other version, bundle or accessory, with the evidence for that call. This is the only place a reseller is identified rather than guessed. Pass product_id from search_products (or its product_url). Examples: "is this seller an authorized reseller", "which stores carry the exact same jacket".

product_id.description: product_id from search_products. Don't construct URLs.

name: get_passport
title: Get product passport
